applies_when: A matrix with many more rows than columns
Linear magnitude lookup with adopted fixed numeric bounds
caption: heatmap-tall-narrow/caption.md
mechanism: Matrix shape and labels set data-region geometry; visible subordinate seams separate large cells without changing the scale.
avoid: Stretching a three-column matrix into wide ribbons weakens local reading; disappearing cell seams make nearby pale values merge.
source_anchors: scWAT Fig.2b PDF p4: compact narrow matrix
The blue ramp and seams are declared EasyViz adaptations
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 88 × 88 mm; declared data region: 28.16 × 67.76 mm from the fixed margins.
The fixed margins allocate a tall, narrow data region to twelve rows and three columns; automatic cell aspect follows that region. A vertical colorbar uses the space reserved on the right.
